name: capcut_create_video_bridge
description: Orchestrates the Direct Video Track Bridge: creates a CapCut draft around a pre-rendered 60 FPS master video plate (Remotion/WebGL), separates multi-track audio, and auto-imports subtitles into editable tracks.

filePath.description: Absolute path to audio track file.

fps.description: Canvas frame rate (default 60fps for high-end motion).

subtitles_srt_path.description: Optional SRT file path to import as editable subtitles.

video_plate_path.description: Absolute file path to pre-rendered master video plate (.mp4).
